description: This file defines a utility enum 'PermissionMonitoringSupport' that manages permission monitoring state, including registration and deregistration of permission monitors.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the boolean parameter, registering or unregistering the monitor accordingly.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring if it is currently active, unregistering the PermissionMonitor.
